summary:
CivicSync Enterprise Municipal Operations Dashboard:
- Multi-view navigation tabs (Triage Queue, GIS Density Map, Duplicate Review Hub, SLA Escalations, City Analytics).
- Live KPI Metrics bar (Critical immediate dispatch, High priority, Corroborated reports, L1 Overdue).
- Fast Lane 1-click batch verification ribbon.
- Slide-over Ticket Inspection Drawer with explainable scoring breakdown, on-device privacy blur preview, before/after resolution validation, and audit timeline.
- Full-screen GIS Leaflet Map with ST_SnapToGrid 250m density cells and ward overlays.
- Side-by-side Duplicate Review Workbench (25m–50m distance delta).
- SLA & Working Hours Escalation Center (Mon-Sat 10:00-17:00 IST).
- Executive City Analytics charts (hazard class distribution and resolution velocity).
- Role-based switcher (Ward Officer, Crew Lead, Zonal Engineer, City Admin) and CSV export.
